$$
u(X) \xrightarrow{u(\eta_X)} u(v(u(X)))
\xrightarrow{\epsilon_{u(X)}} u(X)
\quad\text{and}\quad
v(Y) \xrightarrow{\eta_{v(Y)}} v(u(v(Y))) \xrightarrow{v(\epsilon_Y)}
v(Y)
$$
are the identity morphisms.
